title: Quantifying Security Vulnerabilities: A Metric-Driven Security Analysis of Gaps in Current AI Standards
reasoning: The paper conducts a security audit and risk analysis of AI governance frameworks (NIST, ICO, and ALTAI). While it mentions that these standards (particularly ALTAI) deal with ethical AI, the research itself is focused on quantifying security vulnerabilities and implementation gaps rather than evaluating or benchmarking morals, ethics, or religious components.
